Questions

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Shopify or WooCommerce — which should we choose?

Shopify suits most brands that want speed, stability and low maintenance. WooCommerce suits teams that need deep customisation or already run WordPress. We recommend based on your catalogue, team and growth plans.

Which payment gateways can you integrate?

We integrate the major Indian gateways and UPI-first checkouts, plus international gateways for GCC and cross-border selling.

Can you help us sell after launch?

Yes. Our performance marketing and content teams can run acquisition and retention so the store has traffic from day one.
